_readme: super-ai-gen manifest. Copy to <PROJECT>/Creatives/<slug>.json. Values the brand owns
(account, workspace, models_allowed, rates, product registry) come from clients.json - never here.
project.client MUST equal the --client flag and the Creatives/_preflight.json marker, or fire.py refuses.
Placeholders: any <TOKEN> in project.placeholders is replaced byte-identically in every prompt and action.
Locks: voice_lock is pasted VERBATIM into every speaking shot - one voice across independent gens.
Kinds: TH/VO speak on camera (on_camera_kinds); a dialogue line on any other kind gets locks.offscreen appended.
Refs: project.refs maps a name to a flat file; a <name>_panels folder beside it wins (charsheet.py --crop).
Cast lock: a character entity on camera in 2+ shots declares master (a still tag) + voice ({vo: <VO file>} or {lock: <name>}); castlock.py refuses motion otherwise.
Naming: prefixed_takes -> Elements/Clips/<prefix>_<tag>_vNN.mp4 (regen = next vN in place).

locks.voice_lock: <who they sound like: age, region, energy, then the capture: dry, close, minimal room>
locks.negative_base: text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, morphing
locks.offscreen: IMPORTANT: the dialogue is voice-over narration from an unseen narrator. NOBODY visible in this shot speaks.
locks.notext: Absolutely no text anywhere in frame.

lens._default: phone camera, flat, no cinematic bokeh

motion_style._default: authentic phone footage, photoreal, no colour grading

shots.action: the camera pushes in slowly as she talks to the phone
